subject.title: refactor(sqlite): drop write-only verification history and share the terminal-open latch

question: Should the repository accept normal-open deletion of `database_verifications` on the confirmed premise that this transient table was never included in any released build?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes persisted-state handling without a schema-version migration; the repository policy permits dropping unreleased transient state, but that release-boundary premise needs an accountable maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Confirm unshipped transient state
options.body: Confirm the table was main-only and accept the normal-open drop after live migration and latch proof is attached.

options.title: Preserve a migration record
options.body: Require a narrowly documented migration or alternate handling if release history shows any supported build could contain meaningful verification history.

recommendation.title: Confirm unshipped transient state
recommendation.body: Confirm the table was main-only and accept the normal-open drop after live migration and latch proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the affected verifier and dedicated-quarantine ownership paths in the immediately preceding merged work.
